title: Lenses
description: The views kept on the map: the lenses, styles and layouts kept and what each is about, the picture a kept view draws and where an item is drawn, the saved views a person picks from, the hubs that need views of their own, where a view is seen at work, the moves that gave views their flat lens and their life, a type's new name in the views that named the old one, and an agent's view refused when one is kept already.
